pack.toybox.description: Realm Toybox Vanilla Compat v0.9.0-compat4 — Java 26.2
item.toybox.grappling_hook.lore: Cast at a block to pull yourself in; sneak to cancel.
message.toybox.enabled: [Toybox] Vanilla Compat v0.9.0-compat4 enabled. Help: /trigger tb_help
message.toybox.help.title: Realm Toybox Vanilla Compat v0.9.0-compat4 | Java 26.2
message.toybox.help.blast: • Blast I–III: ground impact explosions are raised above the block; incompatible with Multishot/Piercing
message.toybox.help.rift_shot: • Rift Shot: sneak at an 8–48 block impact; costs 2.5 hearts and has a 3s cooldown
message.toybox.help.springstep: • Leap I–III: hold jump while rising for a higher jump; release early for a short jump
message.toybox.help.jump_pad: • Jump Pad: place an iron weighted pressure plate on yellow glazed terracotta; step off onto normal ground to re-arm
message.toybox.help.grappling: • Grappling Hook: cast the dedicated fishing rod at a block; sneak to cancel
message.toybox.rift_shot.blocked: [Toybox] Rift Shot needs sneak, 8–48 blocks, clear arrival space, and no cooldown.
message.toybox.help.wingbound: • Wingbound Chestplate: combine a chestplate + elytra in a crafting grid for armor and gliding
message.toybox.help.wind_bottle: • Wind Bottle: glass bottle + wind charge + feather
message.toybox.help.anvil: • Anvil renewal: drop the worked item + 1 Nether Star together on an anvil; its tooltip shows the current penalty
message.toybox.help.levels: • Vanilla caps; Density/Breach/Sharpness/Smite/Bane coexist on maces, as do all four Protections, Mending/Infinity, and Multishot/Piercing
message.toybox.help.alchemy: • Potion synthesis: hold one potion in each hand, carry the catalyst, then use a brewing stand; caps are V and 60 minutes
message.toybox.help.measure: • Measuring tape: start/end with /trigger tb_measure; also reports inclusive size, area, and safe volume
message.toybox.help.chalk: • Chalk: /trigger tb_chalk set 1..8 saves a slot; /trigger tb_chshow set 1..8 shows it for 5 seconds
message.toybox.help.soup: • Soup Pot: put 4 matching vanilla soups into a cauldron over a lit campfire with /trigger tb_soup set 1; serve with set 2 and remove with set 3
message.toybox.jump_pad.blocked: [Toybox] Jump Pad needs five clear blocks above it. Step off to re-arm it.
message.toybox.measure.unsupported_dimen: [Toybox] Measuring is supported only in the Overworld, Nether, and End.
message.toybox.measure.start: [Toybox] Measurement start saved at %s, %s, %s. Run the trigger again at the endpoint.
message.toybox.measure.result: [Toybox] ΔX %s, ΔY %s, ΔZ %s | straight %s blocks | Manhattan %s blocks
message.toybox.measure.dimension_mismatc: [Toybox] Return to the dimension containing the saved start point, or cancel with /trigger tb_measure set 2.
message.toybox.measure.too_far: [Toybox] Each coordinate difference must be at most 26,000 blocks.
message.toybox.chalk.unsupported_dimensi: [Toybox] Chalk is supported only in the Overworld, Nether, and End.
message.toybox.chalk.invalid_slot: [Toybox] Chalk slot must be from 1 to 8.
message.toybox.chalk.dimension_mismatch: [Toybox] Chalk marks can be shown only from their saved dimension.
message.toybox.chalk.shown: [Toybox] Showing chalk slot %s for 5 seconds at %s, %s, %s.
message.toybox.chalk.stopped_dimension: [Toybox] Chalk display stopped after a dimension change.
message.toybox.alchemy.invalid: [Toybox] Unsupported or unsafe potion data. Effects must be vanilla IDs, level I–V, 1–72000 ticks, with no hidden or duplicate effect.
message.toybox.alchemy.choose_mode: [Toybox] For one matching effect, carry glowstone only for potency or redstone only for duration.
message.toybox.alchemy.overlap: [Toybox] Multi-effect potions may be fused only when their effect IDs do not overlap.
message.toybox.alchemy.too_many: [Toybox] A mixed potion can contain at most five effects.
message.toybox.alchemy.cost: [Toybox] Missing experience or catalysts (amethyst, mode dust, or bottle-promotion reagent).
message.toybox.alchemy.apply_failed: [Toybox] The result bottle could not be created; nothing else was consumed.
message.toybox.anvil.need_item: [Toybox] This trigger is now informational; use the Nether Star ritual.
message.toybox.anvil.hint: [Toybox] Drop the worked item and 1 Nether Star together on top of an anvil.
message.toybox.anvil.success: [Toybox] Consumed 1 Nether Star and reset the item's prior-work penalty.
message.toybox.soup.invalid_action: [Toybox] Soup Pot action must be 1, 2, or 3.
message.toybox.soup.no_cauldron: [Toybox] Face an empty cauldron within 5 blocks.
message.toybox.soup.need_structure: [Toybox] The empty cauldron needs a lit regular campfire directly below it.
message.toybox.soup.unsupported: [Toybox] Hold mushroom stew, rabbit stew, or beetroot soup in your main hand.
message.toybox.soup.need_four: [Toybox] You need four soups of the held vanilla type.
message.toybox.soup.cap: [Toybox] The server-wide limit of 64 Soup Pots has been reached.
message.toybox.soup.load_failed: [Toybox] Soup Pot registration failed; nothing was consumed.

message.toybox.soup.loaded_rabbit: [Toybox] Rabbit Stew Pot loaded with 4 servings.
message.toybox.soup.loaded_beetroot: [Toybox] Beetroot Soup Pot loaded with 4 servings.
message.toybox.soup.no_pot: [Toybox] This cauldron is not a loaded Soup Pot.
message.toybox.soup.empty_hand: [Toybox] Empty your main hand before taking a serving.
message.toybox.soup.need_lit: [Toybox] Relight the campfire before serving soup.
message.toybox.soup.serve_failed: [Toybox] The serving could not be placed; no serving was consumed.
message.toybox.soup.removed: [Toybox] Soup Pot removed. Remaining servings were discarded.
message.toybox.soup.broken: [Toybox] The Soup Pot structure was broken, so its remaining servings were discarded.
message.toybox.soup.corrupt: [Toybox] Invalid Soup Pot data was removed without giving an item.
message.toybox.help.compass: • Chalk Compass: hold exactly one compass plus 1 amethyst, then /trigger tb_compass set 1..8

message.toybox.measure.geometry_wall_onl: [Toybox] Four-wall face area %s | volume omitted because it exceeds the safe score range

message.toybox.measure.geometry_too_larg: [Toybox] Four-wall face area and volume were omitted because they exceed the safe score range.
message.toybox.compass.invalid_slot: [Toybox] Compass target slot must be from 1 to 8.
message.toybox.compass.need_compass: [Toybox] Hold a regular compass in your main hand.
message.toybox.compass.single: [Toybox] Hold exactly one compass so no stacked compasses are lost.
message.toybox.compass.need_shard: [Toybox] You need 1 amethyst shard to attune the compass.
message.toybox.compass.invalid_dimension: [Toybox] That chalk slot has invalid dimension data; save it again.

message.toybox.compass.modified: [Toybox] Use an unmodified compass; attuned or custom compasses are not overwritten.
item.toybox.harvest_sickle.lore.use: Hold use while aiming at a mature crop to harvest a 3x3 area.
item.toybox.harvest_sickle.lore.crops: Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, and nether wart.
item.toybox.harvest_sickle.lore.cost: Costs 1 durability per successful sweep; crops are not replanted.
message.toybox.help.sickle: • Harvest Sickle: hold use while aiming at a mature crop to harvest a 3x3 area; no automatic replanting
